title: Edge-Computing Reference Architecture for Real-Time Structural Health Monitoring: reference implementation and public-data validation
description: Reference implementation, download scripts, front-end configurations, detectors, training configuration, per-window outputs and diagnostics for the paper 'An Edge-Computing Reference Architecture for Real-Time Structural Health Monitoring: Design and Validation on Three In-Service Bridges'. Every number in the paper is regenerated from openly licensed monitoring data from the KW51 (Leuven), Vänersborg and Chillon bridges.
